evals.title: Patient search
evals.prompt: Design patient search for a large clinic with similar names and multiple identifiers.
evals.expected_output: Search results optimized for disambiguation with stable identity fields; no avatar-card grid.
assertions: The work object dominates over KPI summaries.
Search/list results provide task-appropriate identity disambiguation.
Sorting/filter/scope state remains visible.
Operational state and clinical severity are not conflated.
Bulk/action scope is explicit.
No-match is distinct from load failure.
